results.title: ‘200 Cr Par Dhyaan Do’ Rakhi Sawant’s Advice to Sunita Ahuja Amid Govinda’s Marriage Rumours
results.description: Sunita Ahuja and Govinda were rumoured to get divorced, but the case was withdrawn by Sunita later as she was spotted outside a family court with their son Yashwardhan. There has been a long-standing public feud between the couple, especially because of the actor’s upcoming movie. Govinda has been spotted around town with co-star Komal Rani Swarnkar. The two were rumoured to be together and Ahuja also called Govinda her ‘sugar daddy’. Now, Rakhi Sawant has some advice for her.Rakhi Sawant’s Advice for Sunita Ahuja © Instagram/officialsunitaahujaSpeaking to the media, Sunita Ahuja made a bombshell revelation that Govinda and Komal Rani Swarnkar were planning to get married once the divorce would be finalised. Swarnkar isn’t just planning to make her Bollywood debut alongside Govinda with Roopa, but she was also rumoured to be in a relationship with him.Although the actor had denied these claims and reprimanded Ahuja for saying such things, she remains adamant on that being the case. “Maine kal divorce case wapas le liya kyunki woh shaadi karne ke plan me the woh log (I withdrew the divorce case yesterday because they were planning to get married).” Many were confused as to why Sunita would withdraw the divorce case, considering that their marriage problems had been public knowledge for quite some time now. Not divorcing him would keep Govinda from marrying another woman.Rakhi Sawant immediately jumped to her support, “That’s good. Like I said, you did the right thing by withdrawing the case.”She continued, “Aap ₹200 crore par dhyaan do. Sab chhodo. Doosri-teesri koi aa gayi na, sab hadap legi. Aap pehle apne naam sab kuch kar lo please, meherbaani (Just focus on the ₹200 crore. Forget everything else. If some other woman comes along, she’ll snatch it all up. Please, do me a favor and get everything transferred to your name first).”Her advice was to make sure Sunita Ahuja wasn’t left financially stranded because of her husband’s shortcomings. Most women fear divorce because of a lack of financial independence and Rakhi doesn’t want Sunita to fall in the same boat. “Ghar ki aurat galat nahi hai. Main uske saath hoon (The woman of the house is not in the wrong. I stand with her).” Govinda had been quick to warn Sunita after the sugar daddy remarks, asking her to mind her language. Afterwards, she was spotted making rounds to the Bandra Family Court alongside her son Yashvardhan. Later, it was confirmed that the divorce appeal had been withdrawn.
